title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
seeking an experienced Cloud Security Engineer to strengthen security across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments. The role focuses on Cloud Security Engineering, Vulnerability Management, and Security Operations, ensuring secure cloud deployments, proactive risk management, and effective threat detection and response. Experience in security automation is considered an added advantage.  

Key Responsibilities  

Cloud Security Engineering  

  

. Implement and maintain cloud security controls across AWS, Azure, and GCP.  

. Manage IAM, least privilege access, encryption, secrets management, and key management solutions.  

. Secure cloud workloads, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud native services.  

. Conduct security assessments and drive remediation of identified risks.  

  

Vulnerability Management  

  

. Perform vulnerability assessments and risk based prioritization of findings.  

. Coordinate remediation activities with infrastructure, platform, and application teams.  

. Monitor vulnerability remediation SLAs and provide KPI/KRI reporting.  

. Support patch management and continuous risk reduction initiatives.  

  

Cloud Security Operations  

  

. Monitor cloud environments for threats, vulnerabilities, and security misconfigurations.  

. Investigate and respond to security incidents and alerts.  

. Perform threat hunting, log analysis, and security event investigations.  

. Collaborate with SOC and engineering teams to improve overall security posture.  

  

Automation (Good to Have)  

  

. Support automation of security processes, reporting, compliance checks, and remediation workflows.  

. Exposure to Python, PowerShell, Bash, Terraform, SOAR, or related automation technologies is desirable.  

  

  

  

  

  

Required Skills  

  

. Hands on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP security services.  

. Strong understanding of cloud security architecture, IAM, networking, and data protection.  

. Experience in vulnerability management, incident response, and threat detection.  

. Knowledge of container and Kubernetes security.  

. Exposure to SIEM, EDR, CSPM, CNAPP, or related security platforms.  

.  

  

  

  

  

Hybrid working in client office as per the client business hours policy  

Support in non business hours and weekend in case of tools outage or emergency troubleshooting  

Support in non business hours and weekend for maintenance window with a compensatory hours

title: Salesforce Technical Lead
description:
**6 \- 8 Years of Experience of Experience**
--------------------------------------------


### **Location: Coimbatore**

  

  

### **Job Summary**


We are seeking an experienced **Salesforce Technical Lead** to lead the design, development, and implementation of scalable Salesforce solutions. The role involves hands\-on development, technical decision\-making, and mentoring the Salesforce development team while collaborating closely with stakeholders to deliver high\-quality business solutions.


**Roles \& Responsibilities**
-----------------------------


* Lead the end\-to\-end technical design and development of Salesforce solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and custom applications
* Translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable Salesforce technical solutions
* Provide technical leadership to Salesforce developers, including code reviews and best practice guidance
* Design and implement Apex classes, triggers, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura components, and Visualforce pages
* Ensure Salesforce implementations adhere to security, performance, and governor limits
* Integrate Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, and ETL tools
* Manage deployments using CI/CD pipelines, version control, and Salesforce DX
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues and ensure timely resolution
* Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, and QA teams throughout the SDLC
* Stay updated with Salesforce releases, features, and industry best practices
* Support production issues and provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer.

**Technical Skills**


* Strong expertise in **Salesforce Apex**, **Triggers**, **SOQL/SOSL.**
* Hands\-on experience with **Lightning Web Components (LWC)** and Aura.
* Experience with **Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.**
* Strong knowledge of **Salesforce security model**, sharing rules, and profiles.
* Experience with **Salesforce integrations** (REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, middleware tools)
* Experience with **Salesforce DX**, Git, CI/CD, and deployment tools.
* Familiarity with **asynchronous processing** (Batch Apex, Queueable, Scheduled Apex)

**Functional \& Leadership Skills**


* Ability to lead technical teams and mentor junior developers.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Experience working in **Agile/Scrum** environments.
